author: ojiudezue
title: Lock boot recheck: remember manual unlocks; vacation re-locks after restart like sleep
summary: The garage-lockout regime gains a 120 s post-boot recheck that engages/releases to match house state. Operator chose option B: a manual unlock (and a hazard, kill-switch or vacation-arrival release) is persisted per episode in the regime Store so a restart in the same sleep/vacation/guest-night does not re-lock; vacation now catches up at any hour.
why: A restart during sleep left the house unlocked (boot never engaged), but a naive catch-up would re-lock a door a resident had deliberately unlocked. Persisting the episode mark makes the catch-up safe and lets INV-5 (manual vacation unlock survives restart) hold by data instead of by a vacation carve-out. Review B showed a fire release followed by a crash would otherwise re-lock 120 s after boot.
alternatives_considered: A: accept a re-lock after a night restart
implications: Missing/corrupt Store fails secure (locks). A late 'unlocked' readback is counted as a manual unlock (fails open for the episode, documented B-4). The mark clears on any awake/home edge, backstop, SC disable or new engage edge.
revisit_trigger: Live: a remembered unlock is not honoured after a restart, or a lock re-engages after a hazard release + restart
